Spline fits of the SHCS and SardiNIA trajectories, with the VAF speed and acceleration.

- **Trajectories.** SardiNIA: `resources/LoD/sardinia_chip_calls_long_filtered.txt` (`1_variant_calls/04_SardiNIA_CHIP_trajectories.Rmd`).
  SHCS: `resources/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt` (`1_variant_calls/02_SHCS_CHIP_trajectories.Rmd`). In both,
  the not detected timepoints are at half the LoD of the timepoint.
- **Spline.** The main specification of `spline_functions.R` (`spec_main` = `r spec_main_name`: penalised regression spline
  with REML smoothness, at most `k` = `r spec_main$value` basis functions and at most as many as the trajectory has distinct ages), for both
  cohorts. Other spline settings are compared in `4_sensitivity_analyses/01_spline_sensitivity_and_simulation.Rmd`.
- **LoD / 2 in place of 0%.** The spline can come down to, or below, 0% between measurements.
  `VAF` is floored at half the trajectory-specific LoD
  (`traj_lod`, the mean LoD of the timepoints of the trajectory): below this value a clone cannot be told from one that is
  not detected. All values below it are floored, not only those <= 0, otherwise a curve value just above 0 would stay below the
  floored 0. The curve before the floor is kept in `VAF_spline`; speed and acceleration are derivatives of the spline and do not change.

The notebook writes `resources/LoD/SHCS_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt` and
`resources/LoD/Sardinia_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt`, and the curves of all SardiNIA trajectories to
`figures/LoD/Sardinia_predicted_traj_speed_accel.pdf`. Extrapolation is in `02_ages_at_LoD2_and_2pct.Rmd`.


# 1. Data

```{r data}
sard_calls <- read.table(file.path(resources_lod, "sardinia_chip_calls_long_filtered.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()
shcs_calls <- read.table(shcs_calls_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% as_tibble()

# the two cohorts carry the same columns for the spline functions
stopifnot(all(sard_calls$Age %% step == 0), all(shcs_calls$Age %% step == 0),
          n_distinct(select(sard_calls, traj_id, traj_lod_mean)) == n_distinct(sard_calls$traj_id),
          n_distinct(select(shcs_calls, traj_id, traj_lod_mean)) == n_distinct(shcs_calls$traj_id))

lod_sard <- sard_calls %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)
lod_shcs <- shcs_calls %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)

bind_rows(shcs_calls %>% transmute(Cohort = "SHCS", ID = as.character(ID), traj_id, source),
          sard_calls %>% transmute(Cohort = "Sardinia", ID, traj_id, source)) %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(individuals = n_distinct(ID), trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), measurements = n(),
            `imputed (LoD/2)` = sum(source == "imputed"),
            `trajectories with an imputed timepoint` = n_distinct(traj_id[source == "imputed"])) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Trajectories")
```


# 2. Curves within the observed ages

Each trajectory is smoothed on its own and predicted every `step` = `r step` years; the speed (VAF / year) is the forward
difference of the curve over `step` years, the acceleration (VAF / year^2) the difference of consecutive speeds (0 at the
first age by construction). A trajectory with 3 measurements gets the midpoint of its first two measurements as a 4th point.

```{r predict}
# the columns of the SHCS curves; the extrapolated curves, the ages and the summary come from the same functions
sard_res <- run_pipeline(sard_calls, spec_main, lod_sard)
shcs_res <- run_pipeline(shcs_calls, spec_main, lod_shcs)

floor_lod2 <- function(pred, lod) {
  pred %>%
    left_join(lod %>% rename(traj_lod = lod), by = "traj_id") %>%
    mutate(VAF_spline = VAF, VAF = pmax(VAF_spline, traj_lod / 2))
}

curve_cols <- c("Age", "ID", "traj_id", "VAF", "VAF_spline", "VAF_speed", "VAF_acceleration", "N_CHIP", "Gene.refGene", "data_point",
                "Time", "VAF_acceleration_sign", "traj_lod")

predicted_sard <- floor_lod2(sard_res$pred, lod_sard) %>% select(all_of(curve_cols))
predicted_shcs <- floor_lod2(shcs_res$pred, lod_shcs) %>% select(all_of(curve_cols))

stopifnot(setequal(predicted_sard$traj_id, sard_calls$traj_id), setequal(predicted_shcs$traj_id, shcs_calls$traj_id),
          !anyNA(predicted_sard$VAF), !anyNA(predicted_shcs$VAF))
```

Points of the curves that the floor changes. Measured timepoints are the points of the curve at the age of a measurement:

```{r floor-table}
bind_rows(predicted_shcs %>% select(-ID) %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), predicted_sard %>% select(-ID) %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(`curve points` = n(), trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id),
            `points <= 0` = sum(VAF_spline <= 0),
            `points between 0 and LoD / 2` = sum(VAF_spline > 0 & VAF_spline < traj_lod / 2),
            `trajectories with a floored point` = n_distinct(traj_id[VAF_spline < traj_lod / 2]),
            `measured timepoints` = sum(data_point == 1),
            `measured timepoints floored` = sum(VAF_spline < traj_lod / 2 & data_point == 1)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r save-curves}
write.table(predicted_sard, file.path(resources_lod, "Sardinia_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(predicted_shcs, file.path(resources_lod, "SHCS_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

One trajectory per panel: the measurements (filled circle: read counts; open circle: imputed), the curve (VAF, grey), its
speed (orange) and acceleration (red), on the secondary axis (scaled by the ratio of the maximum VAF to the maximum speed).
Green dotted line: LoD / 2 of the trajectory.

```{r plot-function}
source_shapes <- c("read_counts" = 16, "imputed" = 1)

plot_curves <- function(pred, obs, title) {
  sf <- max(pred$VAF) / max(pred$VAF_speed)
  if (!is.finite(sf) || sf == 0) sf <- 1
  stats <- function(x) paste0("max = ", round(max(x), 4), "\n", "mean = ", round(mean(x), 4), "\n",
                              "median = ", round(median(x), 4), "\n", "min = ", round(min(x), 4), "\n")
  rng <- range(c(pred$VAF, pred$VAF_speed * sf, pred$VAF_acceleration * sf))
  ggplot(pred, aes(x = Age, y = VAF)) +
    geom_line(aes(color = "VAF"), linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = VAF_speed * sf, color = "VAF_speed"), linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = VAF_acceleration * sf, color = "VAF_acceleration"), linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = Age, y = AF, shape = source), size = 2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = source_shapes) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "VAF", sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / sf, name = "VAF speed/acceleration")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkorange") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = chip_vaf, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = pred$traj_lod[1] / 2, linetype = "dotted", color = "forestgreen") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("VAF" = "grey34", "VAF_speed" = "orange2", "VAF_acceleration" = "red3")) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = stats(pred$VAF_speed), color = "orange2", size = 3,
             x = min(pred$Age) + diff(range(pred$Age)) * 0.1, y = rng[2] - diff(rng) * 0.15) +
    annotate(geom = "text", label = stats(pred$VAF_acceleration), color = "red3", size = 3,
             x = min(pred$Age) + diff(range(pred$Age)) * 0.1, y = rng[1] + diff(rng) * 0.15) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "None", plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
}

trajectories <- sort(unique(predicted_sard$traj_id))
plot_list <- lapply(trajectories, function(id) plot_curves(filter(predicted_sard, traj_id == id), filter(sard_calls, traj_id == id), id))
names(plot_list) <- trajectories
```

Examples: the trajectories with an imputed timepoint and the largest final VAF:

```{r example-trajectories, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
example_ids <- sard_calls %>%
  group_by(traj_id) %>%
  filter(any(source == "imputed")) %>%
  summarise(max_AF = max(AF)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_AF)) %>%
  slice(1:4) %>%
  pull(traj_id)

grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list[example_ids], ncol = 2)
```

```{r save-plots}
pdf(file.path(figures_lod, "Sardinia_predicted_traj_speed_accel.pdf"), width = 10, height = 9)
for (i in seq(1, length(plot_list), by = 6)) gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list[i:min(i + 5, length(plot_list))], ncol = 2, nrow = 3)
dev.off()
```


# 3. Explore the curves

By gene, in both cohorts:

```{r by-gene-lines, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
lines_by_gene <- function(pred, y, hline, ylab, title) {
  pred %>%
    mutate(Gene.refGene = group_genes(Gene.refGene)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = .data[[y]], group = traj_id, color = Gene.refGene)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = hline, linetype = "dashed") +
    ylab(ylab) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "None") +
    facet_wrap(~Gene.refGene)
}

for (v in list(c("VAF", chip_vaf, "VAF"), c("VAF_speed", 0, "VAF speed"), c("VAF_acceleration", 0, "VAF acceleration"))) {
  grid.arrange(lines_by_gene(predicted_sard, v[1], as.numeric(v[2]), v[3], "SardiNIA"),
               lines_by_gene(predicted_shcs, v[1], as.numeric(v[2]), v[3], "SHCS"), ncol = 2)
}
```

The per-trajectory statistics by gene (one value per trajectory; "All genes" is every trajectory). The cohort comparison is in
`6_figures_and_tables/Figure4_FiguresS11_S18.Rmd`.

```{r summary}
summary_table <- function(res, lod) traj_summary(floor_lod2(res$pred, lod), res$ages)

sum_sard <- summary_table(sard_res, lod_sard)
sum_shcs <- summary_table(shcs_res, lod_shcs)

write.table(sum_sard, file.path(resources_lod, "Sardinia_predicted_trajectories_summary.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
write.table(sum_shcs, file.path(resources_lod, "SHCS_predicted_trajectories_summary.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)

bind_rows(sum_shcs %>% count(group) %>% mutate(Cohort = "SHCS"), sum_sard %>% count(group) %>% mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")) %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%d (%.0f%%)", n, 100 * n / sum(n))) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cohort, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Dynamics groups (definition: section 4 of the SHCS splines notebook)")
```

```{r box-by-gene, fig.width=13, fig.height=11}
box_by_gene <- function(sum_df, stat, ylab, hline = 0) {
  d <- bind_rows(sum_df %>% mutate(Gene.refGene = as.character(Gene.refGene)),
                 sum_df %>% mutate(Gene.refGene = "All genes")) %>%
    mutate(Gene.refGene = factor(Gene.refGene, levels = c("All genes", gene_levels)))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(y = .data[[stat]], x = Gene.refGene)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Gene.refGene)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gene_colors) +
    theme_classic() + xlab("") + ylab(ylab) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "None")
  if (!is.null(hline)) p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept = hline, linetype = "dashed")
  p
}

stats_gene <- c(mean_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (mean)", min_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (min)", max_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (max)",
                sd_VAF_speed = "VAF speed (sd)", mean_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (mean)",
                min_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (min)", max_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (max)",
                sd_VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (sd)", max_VAF = "VAF (max)")

do.call(grid.arrange, c(lapply(names(stats_gene), function(s) {
  box_by_gene(sum_sard, s, stats_gene[[s]], if (s == "max_VAF") chip_vaf else 0)
}), ncol = 3, top = "SardiNIA"))
```
